label: In Fine's pure logic of ground, for every type of atoms and every set of assumed sequents…
meaning: A mechanical check of Fine's claim (The Pure Logic of Ground, pp. 6-7) that Transitivity(≺/≺), Amalgamation(≤) and Amalgamation(<) are derivable in PLG, for nonempty families as Fine displays them. It verifies consequence inside the encoded calculus only; it says nothing about which truths actually ground which, and it is not the fact semantics or soundness theorem of Fine's §3.
